terms.comment: Traupman’s verb; classically to fetch out of a store, as wine from a jar (Plaut. Mil. 3.2.18, Lewis & Short).

terms.latin: ex rēte prehendō, prehendere, prehendī, prehēnsum
terms.comment: Traupman’s longer phrase, which spells out where the thing comes from.

sources: Lewis & Short: expromo · Lewis & Short: prehendo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 260, 302, 306.
